meanings.gloss: so that (verb goes to the end)

sentences.text: Ich habe das gemacht, damit du mehr Zeit hast.
sentences.en: I did that so that you'd have more time.

sentences.text: Er macht das, damit seine Kinder etwas essen können.
sentences.en: He does it so that his children can eat something.

sentences.text: Er hat das nur gesagt, damit sie geht.
sentences.en: He only said that so she would leave.

sentences.text: Wir müssen jetzt gehen, damit wir um drei dort sind.
sentences.en: We have to go now so that we're there at three.

meanings.gloss: with it, with that, by that

sentences.en: What do you mean by that?
What am I supposed to do with it?

sentences.text: Damit habe ich nichts zu tun.
sentences.en: I have nothing to do with that.
What did you do with it?
